placement.rationale: A named alternate-world story and its direct sequels, beginning with the 2003 series. Magic and espionage describe Doctor Strange's supernatural investigation and Nicholas Fury's Elizabethan intelligence role. The threatened world supports the epic tone. This is not a main-continuity Modern Timeline event.

editorial.description: Elizabethan versions of Marvel's heroes confront strange storms that threaten their world. Their adventures continue through New World, Fantastick Four and Spider-Man 1602.
